name: Yishijie Canjiuguan
source:
The lively Isekai Bistro is always filled with laughter and surprises. Here, every race and species gathers under one roof to share fine wine, delicious food, and unforgettable memories. Get ready to meet a colorful cast of monster babes and uncover the heartfelt stories behind each and every one!

If you're growing weary of your adventures, why not stop in to enjoy the gentle buzz of booze and let your desires and worries melt away?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3570940/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
热闹的异世界小酒馆总是充满欢声笑语和惊喜。在这里，各个种族、各个物种齐聚一堂，分享美酒、美味佳肴和难忘的回忆。准备好迎接一群色彩缤纷的怪物宝贝，并揭开每个怪物背后的感人故事！

如果你对冒险感到厌倦，为什么不停下来享受酒精的温和嗡嗡声，让你的欲望和忧虑消失呢？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3570940/]Steam[/url]]
